test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Amita’s income in 2019 was Rs. 21,000. She gets an increment of 10% every year. What was her income in 2021?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial Income (P) = ₹21,000

Increment Rate (r) = 10% per year

Time (t) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Income after t years = P(1+(r)/(100))^t

**Calculation:**

Income in 2021 = 21000(1+(10)/(100))²

⇒ 21000(1+0.1)²

⇒ 21000(1.1)² = 21000 × 1.21 = 25410

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
